interpretation: The membership path covers 804 of 1165 main-thread snapshots. All 804 also have visible sectionListElement ancestry.
786 is one dominant sectionListElement call-site node. Other disjoint call sites contribute 13 + 4 + 1 snapshots, totaling 804.
Namespace construction is separated from the remaining lookup/cleanup in the exclusive partition. Nested scope unions overlap and must not be added.
This trace supports investigating the repeated namespace/context work on sectionless slide addition; the matched 1000-slide experiment establishes timing separately.
limitations: The owned process constructs 5000 slides; a requested 2-second trace at nominal 1 ms intervals captures only part of that invocation.
1165 observed main-thread snapshots do not imply 1165 ms of CPU time or a complete construction duration.
The profiled invocation is perturbed by sampling and is not one of the matched 1000-slide timing pairs.
Slide count and stage within an incrementally growing deck affect the phase mix; these percentages cannot be transplanted to 1000-slide timings.
Inlining, symbol merging, unwind gaps and runtime/allocator behavior limit phase attribution. Residual samples remain in their nearest visible enclosing scope.
The context-resolution scope is nested inside namespace construction and is not an additional cost.
No speedup, savings in milliseconds, or before/after sample comparison is inferred.
